Drone 5 flies to target Fixed Target 19, Drone 3 flies to target Fixed Target 7, Drone 7 flies to target Fixed Target 13, and Drone 1 flies to target Fixed Target 1. After reaching the targets, all four drones move west for 93m, then south for 79m, then north for 88m together. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (west 93m, south 79m, north 88m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.

name: Fleet Target Sweep (5 Drones) 1
command: Five-drone target sweep: Drone 4, Drone 3, Drone 13, Drone 7, and Drone 6 take off together to 26 meters altitude. Drone 4 flies to target Fixed Target 6, Drone 3 flies to target Fixed Target 1, Drone 13 flies to target Fixed Target 10, Drone 7 flies to target Fixed Target 11, and Drone 6 flies to target Fixed Target 15. After reaching the targets, all five drones move west for 110m, then south for 87m, then north for 106m together. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (west 110m, south 87m, north 106m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.

name: Target Assignment 50% Progress With 3 Targets
command: Take off necessary drones and assign them to reach required targets Fixed Target 4, Fixed Target 6, and Fixed Target 20; if those targets alone do not exceed 50% session task progress, continue reaching additional assigned targets until progress exceeds 50%.
